title: Mara and the Terminal
author: Silas Voss
blurb: Juniper Blackwood, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
